channel.title: Wire — Databases
channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: PlanetScale now offers dedicated read replicas for Postgres
item.description: Use dedicated read replicas to isolate read-only workloads and distribute your data across data centers around the world. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Heroku Postgres Advanced is now generally available
item.description: Heroku Postgres Advanced is now available. Our new database tier brings decoupled storage, 3x–4x throughput, instance pools, and non-disruptive operations. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: 'PlanetScale Released Text Search and We Have a Lot to Say'
item.description: Two BM25 optimizations and benchmark configuration changes inspired by PlanetScale's TIN benchmarks make ParadeDB's text search faster without changing its document identifiers. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Running Apache Cloudberry as Postgres Extensions
item.description: A personal experiment: Apache Cloudberry, the most up-to-date open-source version of Greenplum, turned into a set of extensions for PostgreSQL 19. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Upgrading a 56TB Database by Mostly Not Moving It
item.description: We had to upgrade our 56TB Aurora Postgres cluster by 31 July without taking Trigger.dev down. Instead of moving the database, we made the problem smaller: new runs and the control plane went to PlanetScale, and the old runs stayed behind. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: How Uber Conquered Database Overload: The Journey from Static Rate-Limiting to Intelligent Load Management

item.description: Microsoft announced the public preview of the pg_duckdb extension for Azure Database for PostgreSQL... Tagged with postgres, duckdb, aws, azure. (1 source: postgresweekly)
